results.answer: Southwest's 87-aircraft fleet was compliant with FAA AD 2020-05-11 (pre-service compliance November 2020) and FAA AD 2022-03-07 (completed April 2022), but as of the 2024 registry it had not yet complied with FAA AD 2024-01-02, which requires MCAS Software v2.0 installation; compliance was due May 15, 2024, with software updates scheduled February-May 2024 at roughly 10 aircraft per month, and all 87 aircraft then running MCAS v1.7.3 against a target of MCAS v2.0 (Boeing SB, Rev 2). MCAS v2.0 supersedes v1.7.3 and is required for compliance with FAA AD 2024-01-02. That AD is effective February 15, 2024 and supersedes AD 2022-03-07.
